source.title: Price Transmission from Bitcoin to Altcoins: High-Frequency Evidence and Implications for Trading Strategy

hypothesis: After unusually large BTC hourly moves, lower-liquidity altcoin perpetuals that have underreacted relative to their causally estimated BTC beta continue moving toward the BTC-implied return over the next few hours.
economic_mechanism: BTC is the dominant information leader; lower-liquidity altcoins incorporate BTC shocks more slowly. A beta-adjusted underreaction gap should therefore predict short-horizon altcoin continuation.
universe: Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals listed by 2021-12-31 (including later-delisted contracts where data exist). At each signal timestamp use the top 100 by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume, then trade only the lower-liquidity half of that eligible set. BTC is the signal leader and is not traded.
feature: At hour t, estimate each altcoin's 168h rolling beta to BTC using returns through t-1 only. Compute gap = beta_i * BTC_return_t - alt_return_t. Trigger only when abs(BTC_return_t) >= 1.5 * trailing 168h BTC return volatility estimated through t-1. Rank the gap cross-sectionally among the lower-liquidity half.
portfolio: On non-overlapping BTC-shock events, equal-weight long top gap quintile / short bottom gap quintile, 0.5 gross each side.
execution: Signal uses close t. Enter no earlier than open t+1; exit at open t+1+H. Enforce exact hourly continuity and no overlapping events.
development_gate: Canonical >=150 shock events, mean event cross-sectional Spearman IC >0.02 with HAC p<0.05, positive top-minus-bottom forward-return spread, canonical net daily-equity Sharpe >0.70 and total return >0, and at least 2/3 horizons profitable after base costs.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0; positive at 2x costs; at least 2/3 horizons positive; 2024 and 2025 non-negative; max drawdown <35%; one-extra-hour execution delay remains positive; excluding strongest traded contributor remains positive; DSR reported.
source_deviation: The paper identifies minute-scale BTC-to-altcoin transmission delays. This preregistered test asks whether a coarser but economically analogous effect survives at 1h data frequency; no order-book or fabricated microstructure variables are used.
